atomo.title: Bruce unit 5 refurbishment begins
atomo.summary: Bruce 5 was taken off-line to begin its Major Component Replacement outage on 1 November, the fourth unit to be refurbished under Bruce Power's plan to renew six of the eight units at the Ontario site.

atomo.title: Urenco USA marks first commercial LEU+ production
atomo.summary: Urenco USA's first cylinder of LEU+ is also the first commercial production of the material in the Western world and ushers in a new era of fuel options, the company says.

atomo.summary: Molten Salt Power Barge developer Saltfoss has notified the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission of its intent to begin pre-application engagement.

atomo.title: Turkey and South Korea explore nuclear financing cooperation
atomo.summary: A framework to evaluate potential cooperation on the financing of nuclear power projects was one of a number of energy-related initiatives agreed between Turkey and South Korea.

atomo.title: Rosatom planning new uranium processing plant
